extension.description: Faithful Helix editor keybindings for VS Code: selection-first editing, multiple cursors, match mode (mi/ma/ms/mr/md), jump labels (gw), tree-sitter textobjects (WASM) and : commands.
command.toggle.title: Helicode: Toggle Helix keybindings
command.normalMode.title: Helicode: Enter normal mode
command.typed.title: Helicode: Run : command
command.showKeymapHelp.title: Helicode: Show keymap reference
command.showLog.title: Helicode: Show log
command.importHelixConfig.title: Import Helix config.toml
command.promptKey.title: Prompt key
config.search.smartCase.description: Case-insensitive search unless the pattern contains an uppercase letter (Helix search.smart-case).
config.search.wrapAround.description: Wrap around the document when searching (Helix search.wrap-around).
config.scrolloff.description: Lines of context kept around the cursor when paging (Helix scrolloff).
config.jumpLabelAlphabet.description: Characters used for `gw` jump labels (Helix jump-label-alphabet).
config.defaultYankRegister.description: Register used by yank/delete/paste when none is selected (Helix default-yank-register). Use "+" to yank to the system clipboard.
config.shell.description: Shell command used for | ! $ and :sh, e.g. ["zsh", "-c"]. Defaults to $SHELL -c.
config.openLineUsesEditorIndent.descript: After `o`/`O`, ask VS Code to re-indent the new line using language indentation rules.
config.notebook.escapeQuitsCellEdit.desc: In notebook cells, Escape in normal mode (with nothing pending) leaves cell editing and focuses the cell list.
config.treeSitter.enabled.description: Enable tree-sitter (WASM) powered textobjects, bracket matching and syntax node selection.
config.treeSitter.maxFileSizeKB.descript: Documents larger than this are not parsed with tree-sitter.
config.treeSitter.extraGrammars.descript: Additional grammars keyed by VS Code language id: `{ "lua": { "wasm": "/path/tree-sitter-lua.wasm", "queries": "/path/queries", "language": "lua" } }`. Grammars listed in the extension's manifest can instead be installed with `:tree-sitter-install`.
config.keys.description: Keymap overrides in Helix `config.toml` style, keyed by mode: `{ "normal": { "C-s": ":w", "g": { "a": "code_action" } }, "insert": { "j": { "k": "normal_mode" } } }`. Values are Helix command names, `:typed commands`, or arrays of commands.
config.shell.output.enum.beside: Open the output beside the current editor without taking focus.
config.shell.output.enum.here: Open the output in the current editor group.
config.shell.output.enum.below: Split the current group down and open the output there.
config.undo.enum.helix: Helix history: one undo step per command and per insert session; enables time travel (`:earlier 10s`).
config.undo.enum.vscode: VS Code's own undo stack (typing is grouped by word, no time travel).
config.autoInfo.description: Show the which-key style popup listing the available keys while a minor mode (`g`, `m`, `Space`, `Ctrl-w`, `[`, `]`, `z`) or a key prompt (`mi`, `ms`, `"`) waits for input (Helix `auto-info`).
config.autoInfoDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before the which-key popup appears. 0 shows it immediately.
config.passthroughKeys.description: VS Code keys Helicode must **not** intercept, so your own keybindings win. Use VS Code key names, e.g. `["ctrl+w", "ctrl+f", "alt+d"]`. For a chord such as `ctrl+w s`, list the first key (`ctrl+w`).
config.listNavigation.description: Helix-style navigation in VS Code lists and trees (explorer, search results, source control, problems): `j`/`k`, `gg`/`G`, `Ctrl-d`/`Ctrl-u`, `h`/`l` to collapse/expand, `/` to filter.
config.importHelixConfig.description: Import `[keys.*]` and the supported `[editor]` options from a Helix `config.toml` (`.helix/config.toml` in the workspace, `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/helix`, `~/.config/helix`). Also available as `:config-import`.
config.importHelixConfig.enum.ask: Offer to import an existing Helix config.toml the first time Helicode starts.
config.importHelixConfig.enum.always: Import it on every start (your `helicode.keys` entries still win).
config.importHelixConfig.enum.never: Never look for a Helix config.
config.title: Helicode
config.windowKeysEverywhere.description: Make `Ctrl-w` window mode work outside text editors too, as a VS Code chord, so one keymap drives the whole window. The letters match [Corral](https://github.com/s-tatsuya/corral)'s `ctrl+b` prefix table.
config.windowKeysEverywhere.enum.all: Everywhere, including terminals. `Ctrl-w` then stops reaching the shell (readline's delete-word).
config.windowKeysEverywhere.enum.editors: Lists, views and webviews, but not terminals, where `Ctrl-w` keeps its shell meaning.
